description: Judge well, see situations and make smart choices. Use discernment. #discernment #selfleadership #selflove
transcript: Leading with discernment allows me to live a proactive life. Discernment allows me to judge well, be solution oriented, and see things for what they are, not what I wish them to be. I am able to dissect between what's fake and what's real. That doesn't mean that I always follow that, and when I don't lead with discernment, I am always punished for that. I have the intuition to lead myself and lead well.
